newsitem.title: FRANCE: Usinor makes buyout bid for Allevard.
newsitem.headline: Usinor makes buyout bid for Allevard.

text.p: French steelmaker Usinor Sacilor said on Tuesday that its Ascometal unit was launching a buyout offer for the remaining 32.7 percent capital of Allevard Industries that it does not already own.
It said the offer was priced at 385 francs per share.
In a statement released at a news conference, Usinor said the buyout offer would be followed by the merger of Allevard with Ascometal.
Usinor said the 385 francs per share bid represented a premium of 57 percent over Allevard's closing share price of 245 francs in Paris last Friday.
Trading in the share was suspended on Monday.

The offer must be approved by French stock market authorities. Shareholders of Allevard, which makes suspension equipment for the transport industry, and Ascometal will be asked to approve the merger of the two companies at an extraordinary meeting to be held before the end of 1996.
Ascometal is a 99.9 percent-owned unit of Usinor.
